criteria.meaning: Strength of demand within comparable cohorts; frequency, corroboration, and sampling limitations.
Severity of the customer problem and benefit of addressing it.
Verified gap against matched competitor models, years, markets, and trims.
Fit to the target vehicle class and documented needs of the market.
Fit of available rough effort/timing estimates to the planning horizon; unknown without support.
Supported applicability across customer segments and target vehicles.

sensitivity.interpretation: Flag changes in the top shortlist; show overlapping score bounds rather than claiming a definite order.
